articles.title: A part of FTX survived, and it’s the case for the CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: When FTX collapsed, the parts of it bound by law survived. Mainstream finance is now converging with digital assets, and the law built to protect it the same way is the one the Senate did not pass this week, argues Bullish's Randi Abernethy.

articles.title: After a Clarity Act funeral, the crypto world would keep turning
articles.snippet: With the U.S. crypto bill missing a crucial window before the Senate hangs its closed-for-summer sign, the alternatives are getting more attention.

articles.title: XRP leads majors losses as Clarity Act vote slips to September
articles.snippet: Bitcoin, ether showed slight losses while Ripple-linked XRP fell 5.5% on the week, the worst of the majors, as the Senate left Washington without taking up the market structure bill.

articles.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
articles.snippet: The U.S. Senate won't go on its August recess just yet but it will not vote on the Clarity Act this month, dimming hopes that the bill can become law this year.

articles.title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September
articles.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed that the chamber was “punting” the vote until September.
